name: Anafenza Mevak
description: Valiant Abzan woman from Tarkir; Khan in the original timeline and an ancestral spirit in the current one.

description_citations.text: "Anafenza Mevak". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anafenza Mevak's Kin-Tree is recovered after Dromoka's reign.
timeline.quote: The Kin-Tree of Anafenza Mevak was the first recovered after Dromoka's reign

citation.text: Tree of Redemption (Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Anafenza's family is betrayed to the Sultai; her parents and uncle are slaughtered and Gvar rescues her.
timeline.quote: Anafenza watched her parents and uncle be slaughtered before her Krumar cousin Gvar Barzeel rescued her.

citation.text: "Anafenza Mevak", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At her coronation as Khan she disowns Oret.
timeline.quote: Anafenza publicly and spiritually disowned Oret from her family.

citation.text: "Anafenza Mevak", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the current timeline she kills Gvar in battle and is executed by Oret to save her soul.
timeline.quote: to save her soul, Oret volunteered to execute her

citation.text: "Anafenza Mevak", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: She returns as an ancestral spirit with Oret carving her name into a new ancestor tree.
timeline.quote: she returned to the plane as an ancestral spirit herself

citation.text: "Anafenza Mevak", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Felothar discovers her Kin-Tree and learns of ancient clans from her.
timeline.quote: Felothar spoke with Anafenza and her ancestors

citation.text: "Anafenza Mevak", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Her spirit defends Tarkir during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: The spirit of Anafenza fought in defense of Tarkir during the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Anafenza Mevak", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: her Captain in the current timeline
relations.quote: Oret remained loyal to her, and worked as her Captain

citation.text: "Anafenza Mevak", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
